stories.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
stories.sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
stories.synopsis: Minas Tirith burns. Two hobbits climb Mount Doom. Every blade of grass between matters.

stories.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
stories.sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
stories.synopsis: A broken fellowship, a creature in the marshes, and ten thousand Uruks at the gate of an old fortress.

stories.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
stories.sourceTitle: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
stories.synopsis: An ice planet, a swamp, a city in the clouds, and a sentence at the end of a long fall that you will hear forever.

stories.title: Gladiator
stories.synopsis: A general becomes a slave, becomes a gladiator, becomes the thing that an emperor cannot kill quietly.

stories.title: Inglourious Basterds
stories.synopsis: A Jewish theater owner, a squad of avenging soldiers, and a Nazi premiere with a very flammable nitrate reel.

stories.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
stories.synopsis: A war rig, five wives, and a long road across a desert that goes both ways.

stories.title: Die Hard
stories.synopsis: A cop, a tower, a thief in a sweater, and a vault that nobody is supposed to be able to open on Christmas Eve.

stories.title: John Wick
stories.synopsis: A widower, a puppy, a car, and the very specific organization that did not understand who they had just woken up.

stories.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
stories.synopsis: A boy, a mother in a hospital, an old enemy with a new mission, and a polymorphic cop who will not stop.

stories.title: Aliens
stories.synopsis: Marines, a colony gone silent, a little girl in the vents, and a queen who has a very strong opinion about her eggs.

stories.title: The Godfather Part II
stories.synopsis: A young Vito in New York, a cold Michael in Nevada, and a family that does not survive its own success.

stories.title: 12 Angry Men
stories.synopsis: A jury room, a stalled fan, a knife on a table, and one juror asking whether reasonable doubt has been considered.

stories.title: Fight Club
stories.synopsis: Insomnia, soap, a basement, and a man in the mirror who has finally caught up to you.

stories.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
stories.sourceTitle: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
stories.synopsis: A work-farm transfer, a card table, a fishing trip, and a quiet Indian by a window who has been listening the whole time.

stories.title: It's a Wonderful Life
stories.synopsis: A small-town banker on a bridge, an angel earning his wings, and a Christmas Eve that becomes a ledger of every kindness you forgot doing.

stories.title: The Prestige
stories.synopsis: Two magicians, a transported man, a tank of water, and a notebook that may be telling the truth or the better lie.

stories.title: The Departed
stories.synopsis: A South Boston cop undercover in the Mob, a Mob mole undercover in the cops, and a question of who calls whose phone first.

stories.title: The Green Mile
stories.synopsis: A death row in 1935, a giant inmate who heals what he touches, and a guard who has to decide what mercy means in a green corridor.

stories.title: American History X
stories.synopsis: A skinhead, a brother who idolizes him, three years inside, and a return to a city that hasn't waited.

stories.title: Grave of the Fireflies
stories.synopsis: An older brother, a younger sister, a candy tin of fruit drops, and a country that has run out of room for them.

stories.title: Life Is Beautiful
stories.synopsis: A waiter in Arezzo, a librarian he calls Principessa, and a game in a camp that he invents to keep a small boy alive.

stories.title: Modern Times
stories.synopsis: A factory, a paddy wagon, a department store, and a tramp who keeps walking up the road toward the next horizon.

stories.title: City Lights
stories.synopsis: A tramp, a blind flower girl, a drunken millionaire who only remembers you at night, and a small coin that decides everything.

stories.title: The Great Dictator
stories.synopsis: A Jewish barber, an identical dictator, a balloon globe in an office, and a microphone that changes hands at the worst possible moment.

stories.title: Some Like It Hot
stories.synopsis: Two musicians, a massacre witnessed, a girl's band on a train, and a millionaire on a yacht who is not easy to discourage.

stories.title: Singin' in the Rain
stories.synopsis: A silent star, a starlet with a terrible voice, a chorus girl with talent, and the day the talkies arrived in Hollywood.

stories.title: Toy Story
stories.synopsis: A cowboy doll, a new space ranger, a kid named Andy, and a road trip across a backyard fence that ends at a pizza place.

stories.title: The Apartment
stories.synopsis: An office worker, a key lent to bosses, a sad elevator girl, and a New Year's Eve that finally chooses a person.

stories.title: Amélie
stories.synopsis: A shy waitress at the Two Windmills, a tin box of childhood treasures, and a man in a glass house who has been waiting for someone to listen.

stories.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
stories.synopsis: A concierge, a lobby boy, an inheritance scandal, a painting of a boy with an apple, and a long sled ride down an alpine slope.

stories.title: Interstellar
stories.synopsis: A dying Earth, a wormhole, a daughter you leave behind, and a love that turns out to be a coordinate.

stories.title: Blade Runner
stories.synopsis: A retired blade runner, four replicants in Los Angeles, and a question about a dove on a rooftop.

stories.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
stories.synopsis: An ape, a bone, a black slab, an indifferent computer, and a hotel room at the edge of forever.

stories.title: Arrival
stories.synopsis: Twelve ships, a linguist who dreams about a daughter, and a language that rearranges what time means.

stories.title: Ex Machina
stories.synopsis: A programmer, a tech billionaire's compound, and an android in a glass room who only wants to ride an escalator one day.

stories.title: District 9
stories.synopsis: A bureaucrat enforcing an eviction on a slum of stranded aliens, a black canister, and a transformation that finally costs him his certainty.

stories.title: Children of Men
stories.synopsis: Eighteen years of infertility, a London under refugee crackdown, and a woman in a barn who is the first impossible mother.

stories.title: Wall-E
stories.synopsis: An empty Earth, a small trash compactor robot in love with a videotape, and a sleek probe who arrives looking for a plant.

stories.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
stories.sourceTitle: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
stories.synopsis: A clinic that erases people, a man who would rather keep the wound, and a beach in winter where someone said meet me.

stories.title: Metropolis
stories.synopsis: A city of towers, a workers' city below, a robot of a woman in a chair, and a flood about to rise into the children's lobby.

stories.title: The Shining
stories.synopsis: A winter caretaker, an empty hotel, a boy on a tricycle, and a corridor that has been waiting for the right family.

stories.title: Alien
stories.synopsis: A space tug, a distress beacon, an egg, and a chest cavity that does not appreciate visitors.

stories.title: The Thing
stories.synopsis: An Antarctic research station, a Norwegian helicopter, and a thing that imitates anything it touches.

stories.title: Get Out
stories.synopsis: A photographer meets his girlfriend's family, a kitchen full of help, a teacup that puts him through the floor, and a basement with a slide projector.

stories.title: Hereditary
stories.synopsis: A funeral, a treehouse, a model maker's studio, and a family that finally finds out what grandmother actually believed.

stories.title: Jaws
stories.synopsis: A beach town, a Fourth of July, a chief who hates water, and a great white shark with a long memory.

stories.title: Rosemary's Baby
stories.synopsis: A new apartment in an old building, neighbors who help too much, a tannis root necklace, and a husband who has been making promises behind a wall.

stories.title: The Exorcist
stories.synopsis: A movie-star mother in Georgetown, a small daughter who plays with a board, a priest who is losing his faith, and a long staircase outside a bedroom window.

stories.title: Let the Right One In
stories.synopsis: A bullied boy in a Stockholm suburb, a girl who only comes out at night, a pool, and an invitation that has to be spoken aloud.

stories.title: Night of the Living Dead
stories.synopsis: A cemetery, a farmhouse, a basement argument, and a country radio voice that is finally telling the truth.

stories.title: Palm Royale
stories.synopsis: Palm Beach, 1969. The most exclusive ball of the season has one empty seat and you intend to fill it. Smile. Lie beautifully.

stories.title: Him and Hers
stories.synopsis: A couple, a perfect apartment, and a voice memo neither of you meant to leave running. The truth has forty-three minutes and a timestamp.

stories.title: The Lost Bus
stories.synopsis: A school bus, twenty-two children, and a wildfire that has already eaten the only road home. You are driving. Don't look in the mirror.

stories.title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
stories.sourceTitle: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
stories.synopsis: New town, new school, new everything. You're eleven, you're waiting for your body and your faith to make up their minds, and you keep talking to a God you're not sure is listening.

stories.title: Abbott Elementary
stories.synopsis: There are eleven glue sticks for forty kids and someone unplugged the laminator. It's only Tuesday.

stories.title: Shrinking
stories.synopsis: You're a grieving therapist who has started saying the unsayable thing out loud to your patients. It keeps working. It also keeps blowing up your life. One week. No filter.

stories.title: Dune: Part Two
stories.synopsis: A desert prophet. A vendetta. A choice that will boil the sand.

stories.title: Wuthering Heights
stories.synopsis: Two souls, one wild stretch of moorland, and a love that refuses to behave. Choose between the heart and the world — and learn that the moor keeps every choice you make on it.

stories.title: Black Swan
stories.synopsis: You've earned the lead in Swan Lake — the pure White Swan you were born to dance, and the dark Black Swan you'll have to become. The mirror is starting to disagree with you. How far will you go to be perfect?

stories.title: Hoppers
stories.synopsis: A new gadget lets you beam your mind into a lifelike robot animal and join the creatures of the marsh. You wanted to save the wetland. You didn't expect the animals to have a vote — or to change yours.

stories.title: Severance
stories.synopsis: The doors close. The procedure begins. Who do you become when the floor ticks down?

stories.title: Game of Thrones
stories.synopsis: You inherit a castle the size of a wart, on a road every army wants. Two queens want your sword, three gods want your soul, and your maester is out of wine. Welcome to the game.

stories.title: Something Very Bad Is Gonna Happen
stories.sourceTitle: Something Very Bad Is Gonna Happen
stories.synopsis: You woke up at 4:11 a.m. with the deep, unshakable certainty that something very bad is about to happen — today, here, to someone you love. You have until the end of the day to figure out what, and whether you can stop it.

stories.title: Superstore
stories.synopsis: It's 9:43 p.m. at Cloud 9. The corporate inspector is hiding in Aisle 7, a man has fallen asleep in a kayak, and somebody — possibly Jonah — set off the indoor sprinklers in Pets. You have seventeen minutes to close. Good luck.

stories.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
stories.synopsis: Twenty unpaid weeks, one son, and exactly nineteen other interns competing for the single job at the end. You can't afford to lose. You also can't afford to win.

stories.title: The Bear
stories.synopsis: Forty covers. Three line cooks. One temperamental pilot light. Don't burn it.

stories.title: The Great
stories.synopsis: You arrived in Russia at fifteen, married a man-child emperor at sixteen, and by autumn you have decided, politely, to take the throne for yourself. Huzzah.

stories.title: Wayward
stories.synopsis: Your daughter is enrolled at Tall Pines Academy, the troubled-teen 'school' on the edge of a town where every adult smiles the same way. By morning you'll wish you'd never read the brochure.

stories.title: Bodkin
stories.synopsis: A podcast crew, a sleepy Irish town, and a Samhain festival twenty years ago where three people vanished without a trace. You came for a true-crime story. You'll get a bigger one.

stories.title: Scary Movie 4
stories.synopsis: Aliens. Ghosts. A grim village. A hand reaching out of the well. Also somebody on a unicycle for no reason. Welcome to the parody — pick the dumbest possible choice and probably live.

stories.title: Eternity
stories.synopsis: You died, gently, on a Tuesday. The afterlife is a tasteful hotel with seven days to decide who you want to spend eternity with — your husband of fifty years, or the love you lost at twenty-three.

stories.title: Mercy
stories.synopsis: An AI judge promised perfect justice. You're the defense attorney for a client it just decided is guilty. You have twenty-four hours to convince a machine of something it doesn't have a word for.

stories.title: Invincible
stories.synopsis: You're the strongest person on Earth this week. The Viltrumites are watching, your father is back in your inbox, and you have an econ midterm at 9 a.m. Try not to bleed on the textbook.

stories.title: The Boys
stories.synopsis: You're a junior PR assistant at Vought when an internal video lands in your inbox that could topple Homelander. You have until end of day. Nobody you trust is who you thought.

stories.title: Outcome
stories.synopsis: A career-ending injury. A small-town team that needs you to coach them out of last place. A scout in the stands who could change everything — for a kid who is not your son but might as well be.

stories.title: The Intern
stories.synopsis: You're seventy and a senior intern at a fashion startup run by a woman who is brilliant and bone-tired. You have one job: be useful. You are the only one in the office who has done this work for forty years longer than the founder has been alive.

stories.title: Dune: Part One
stories.synopsis: The Atreides have just landed on Arrakis. Within a week the trap will close. You can see it coming. Your father can't, or won't, in time. Find the thread that lets even one of you survive the betrayal.

stories.title: The Housemaid
stories.synopsis: You took the live-in housekeeping job because nobody else would hire someone with your record. The Winchesters' attic locks from the outside. You'll find out why.

stories.title: Loot
stories.synopsis: Your husband cheated. The divorce settlement gave you eighty-seven billion dollars. Your foundation has a staff of six and a board of one — you — and you don't know what an audit is. Start there.

stories.title: Wicked: For Good
stories.synopsis: Glinda has the crown. Elphaba has the price on her head. You're a school friend from Shiz who knows both of them. You can save one. Maybe.

stories.title: Wolves
stories.synopsis: Two fixers, one body, one Manhattan night. Neither of you was supposed to be assigned to this job. Now you're both here, and the clock is small and meaningless and beautiful.

stories.title: Dhurandhar
stories.synopsis: Karachi. You're an asset of the agency, deeper undercover than your own family. Your handler in Delhi has gone silent. There's a wedding tomorrow you cannot miss.

stories.title: Beast Games
stories.synopsis: A thousand contestants. Millions in prize money. Cameras everywhere. You are contestant #482 and you have made it to the final ten. Don't look at the drones. Or do.

stories.title: A House of Dynamite
stories.synopsis: An ICBM has been launched from somewhere — they don't know where yet — at the United States. You are the Deputy National Security Adviser. You have eighteen minutes before you have to advise.

stories.title: Don't Look Up
stories.synopsis: You found the comet. You also have to do a morning show. The comet does not care about ratings. Neither, soon, will you.

stories.title: Speak No Evil
stories.synopsis: You spent one charming evening with another couple on vacation. They invited you to their country house for the weekend. Every awkward thing you've already overlooked was a warning.

stories.title: The Woman in Cabin 10
stories.synopsis: A luxury cruise. A woman in the next cabin. A splash at two a.m. By morning, the cabin doesn't exist and neither does she. You're a journalist, mid-breakdown, expected to write a glossy travel piece. Try not to.

stories.title: Devs
stories.synopsis: You took the job because the salary made no sense. The lab is in a sealed building only six people enter. Today they handed you a project and a non-disclosure agreement and a small key.

stories.title: Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story
stories.synopsis: Apartment 213 smells wrong again. You live in 212. The police don't listen to women who look like you in this neighborhood. You will have to be the one who is right.

stories.title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
stories.synopsis: Your grandfather's basement contains seventeen file cabinets, a key to a Tokyo apartment, and a black-and-white photograph of him with a Titan. You inherit it all. Try to stay alive.

stories.title: Dhurandhar: Part 2
stories.synopsis: Three years after Karachi, you live in Lonavala under a name that isn't yours. A man you killed once is, apparently, alive. The agency needs you back. Your wife of paper says no.

stories.title: Young Sheldon
stories.synopsis: You're nine, Texan, and smarter than your physics teacher. The county science fair is in two weeks. So is your sister's volleyball game. You have to be in two places. Use your brain.

stories.title: Heartbreak High
stories.synopsis: You made a map of every romantic and sexual connection at your Sydney high school. It got out. Now the school wants you in 'sexual literacy' — and several relationships, including yours, want a word.

stories.title: Imperfect Women
stories.synopsis: Eleanor was your best friend for twenty years. She's been murdered. You and Mary, the third friend, each know exactly half of the secret that killed her. You have to decide whether to tell each other.

stories.title: Sebastian
stories.synopsis: You're a young writer in London with a novel that won't sell. To finish it, you start escorting under a name that isn't yours. You promise yourself you can write your way back out.

stories.title: Bugonia
stories.synopsis: Two cousins have abducted a pharmaceutical CEO they're convinced is an alien queen. You're the CEO. You have until the lunar eclipse to convince them otherwise — or convince yourself they're right.

stories.title: Euphoria
stories.synopsis: You're 20 in East Highland, two years into recovery, working a coffee shop with a sponsor on speed dial. Tonight's meeting is the first you've gone to alone. The town has not gotten quieter.

stories.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
stories.synopsis: Print is dead. Miranda Priestly is not. She has summoned you back to Runway — fifteen years older, a real career later, and with a daughter you can't be late to pick up. The September issue is a relaunch. Try not to fall apart.

stories.title: Smile 2
stories.synopsis: You're on stadium tour. Tonight in Boston a fan smiled at you in a way you can't unsee. The curse is here. The cameras are here. The next show is tomorrow.

stories.title: Off Campus
stories.synopsis: Junior year. A hockey scholarship. A part-time job. A roommate situation that is, depending on the day, a romance. You have eighteen credits and one heart. Choose what to spend them on.

stories.title: Roommates
stories.synopsis: Four people, one apartment in Brooklyn, one chore wheel that has, over six months, become a graph theory problem. Tonight's house meeting is about, ostensibly, the dishwasher.

stories.title: The Boroughs
stories.synopsis: Your retirement community is, unfortunately, haunted by something. You and your bridge club — none of you under seventy-three — have agreed to investigate. Your hearing aids have new uses.

stories.title: Ladies First
stories.synopsis: Your small-town women's coalition has won a council seat. The seat is yours. The town is split. The first session is Monday and the agenda includes a budget you've been fighting for two years.

stories.title: Toaster
stories.synopsis: Your dumb startup makes one product: a smart toaster nobody asked for. You have eight months of runway, a co-founder who's lost the plot, and a pivot meeting on Monday.

stories.title: Stranger Things
stories.synopsis: Hawkins. One more rift. The party is older, the stakes are bigger, and the math homework is, somehow, still due Monday.

stories.title: Hijack
stories.synopsis: Seven hours from Singapore to London. Row 18. Aisle. You're a corporate negotiator on holiday. They picked the wrong plane.

stories.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
stories.sourceTitle: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
stories.synopsis: Your scout troop's overnight camp goes badly when, somehow, half of town becomes flesh-eating. You have a sash, three badges, and a slingshot. Use them.

stories.title: Zero Day
stories.synopsis: A cyberattack takes the country down for one minute and kills three thousand people. You're a former president, asked back to chair the investigation. The answer, you suspect, is in your old administration's closets.

stories.title: Zodiac
stories.synopsis: San Francisco, late seventies. You're the kid in the newsroom who can't stop staring at the killer's ciphers. Your boss doesn't think it's your job. He's wrong.

stories.title: Scary Movie 2
stories.synopsis: You're invited to a haunted mansion 'for a college study.' The professor has one arm. The cat is talking. The chandelier is, somehow, judging you.

stories.title: EuroTrip
stories.synopsis: Graduation week. A penpal in Berlin. Three friends, one rail pass, and an unwise budget. The plane lands in London at 6 a.m. Go.

stories.title: More the Merrier
stories.synopsis: Your in-laws, three exes, a missionary cousin, and an estranged sibling all confirm for Thanksgiving. You have one oven and one nerve left. Cook.

stories.title: Scream
stories.synopsis: Woodsboro's grown up. You host a true-crime podcast about the original killings. A new ghostface debuts on your live stream. Don't pick up the phone.

stories.title: The Bluff
stories.synopsis: You're a retired pirate captain living quietly in the Caribbean. The British Navy has docked. So has your old daughter. So has your old life.

stories.title: Scary Movie 3
stories.synopsis: There's a tape that kills you a week after you watch it. There are crop circles in your uncle's field. There is a rapper named George. Solve all three.

stories.title: Scary Movie 5
stories.synopsis: A cabin in the woods, three found children, and a possessed Roomba. You and your spouse just wanted a vacation.

stories.title: Tell Me Lies
stories.synopsis: Eight years out of college. Your best friend is engaged to the man who ruined your twenties. The bachelorette weekend is in three weeks.

stories.title: A Wrinkle in Time
stories.synopsis: Your dad disappeared into space-time. Three strange Mrs Ws are at the door. The tesseract is, apparently, a verb. Go find him.

stories.title: The Godfather
stories.synopsis: A wedding. A horse's head. A war between five families. You're the youngest son. The family business is, finally, calling you.

stories.title: The Shawshank Redemption
stories.synopsis: You're convicted of a murder you didn't commit. Twenty years in Shawshank Prison. Hope is the most dangerous thing they let you carry.

stories.title: Pulp Fiction
stories.synopsis: A briefcase. A boss's wife. A boxer who didn't throw the fight. You're a hitman in a bad suit. The day has, so far, been long.

stories.title: The Dark Knight
stories.synopsis: Gotham is, by night, mostly yours. A man in face paint has burned a mountain of money. He doesn't want money. You don't know yet what he wants.

stories.title: Forrest Gump
stories.synopsis: Alabama. A bench. A box of chocolates. You don't know what you're going to get. The century, for some reason, keeps happening to you.

stories.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
stories.synopsis: Tatooine. Two suns. Aunt Beru's blue milk. A droid you bought yesterday is, apparently, carrying the plans to a planet-killing weapon. Buckle up.

stories.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
stories.sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
stories.synopsis: A ring you didn't ask for. A road that goes ever on. Nine companions. One dark lord. You're a hobbit, mostly. You have one job.

stories.title: Titanic
stories.synopsis: Southampton, April 1912. You're first class, engaged to a man who keeps a safe of secrets. The man you'll actually fall for is three decks below playing cards for a ticket.

stories.title: Schindler's List
stories.synopsis: Kraków, 1939. You're a German businessman with a gift for getting on the right side of every officer at every party. The Jews of this city are about to need a list with your name on it.

stories.title: The Wizard of Oz
stories.synopsis: Kansas, then not Kansas. A cyclone. A pair of shoes. A road of yellow brick. The lion needs courage. The wizard, you'll find, needs you.

stories.title: Jurassic Park
stories.synopsis: Isla Nublar. A theme park, soft-opening. The fences are electric and the dinosaurs are alive. The power, in two hours, will go off.

stories.title: The Matrix
stories.synopsis: Wake up, Neo. The white rabbit, the office, the call. Red pill, blue pill. Choose what kind of life you were going to have anyway.

stories.title: Avatar
stories.synopsis: Pandora. Floating mountains, glowing forests, a tree as old as your grandmother. You're a marine in a Na'vi body. You're supposed to be spying. You're starting to fall in love.

stories.title: Inception
stories.synopsis: You're a thief who steals secrets from dreams. Tonight's job: plant an idea instead. Your wife is dead. Or she's downstairs.

stories.title: Gone with the Wind
stories.synopsis: Tara, Georgia, 1861. War is coming. You are Scarlett, sharp and impossible. The man you want isn't the man who wants you.

stories.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
stories.synopsis: California suburb. Your parents split. A creature with a glowing finger is in your shed. He wants to go home.

stories.title: Citizen Kane
stories.synopsis: You're a reporter. Charles Foster Kane has died saying one word. Rosebud. Find out what it means before the deadline.

stories.title: Goodfellas
stories.synopsis: As far back as you can remember, you wanted to be a gangster. You got it. Now the day starts at 6 a.m. and ends at 6 a.m. and the helicopter is, again, overhead.

stories.title: The Silence of the Lambs
stories.synopsis: FBI Academy. A senator's daughter is missing. Hannibal Lecter has a profile to share, but only for a song.

stories.title: Saving Private Ryan
stories.synopsis: Omaha Beach, June 6, 1944. The ramp goes down. By the next week you're crossing France for one man whose brothers all died. Earn this.

stories.title: Back to the Future
stories.synopsis: Hill Valley, 1985. The DeLorean. The lightning. You end up in 1955, where your mother has a crush on you. Don't break the timeline.

stories.title: The Lion King
stories.synopsis: Pride Rock. Your father is king. Your uncle has a plan. The savanna stretches forever, until it doesn't.

stories.title: Avengers: Endgame
stories.synopsis: Half of all life is gone. Five years pass. A van pulls up with a man who has been in a smaller place. The time heist begins.

stories.title: Psycho
stories.synopsis: Phoenix. A motel. A bathroom. A boy and his mother. You took forty thousand dollars on impulse. You'll wish you hadn't, soon.

stories.title: Casablanca
stories.synopsis: Casablanca, 1941. You run a small nightclub. Of all the gin joints in all the world, she walks into yours. With her husband. With letters of transit in your safe.

stories.title: Pride and Prejudice
stories.synopsis: Longbourn, regency England. A single man in possession of a good fortune is in want of a wife. Your mother is, somehow, aware of every such man in the county.
Oceania. The Ministry of Truth. Big Brother watches. You buy a diary on impulse. Today you write: down with Big Brother.

stories.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
stories.synopsis: Maycomb, Alabama, summer. You are Scout. Your father, Atticus, will be defending a Black man no Maycomb jury wants acquitted. Don't shoot a mockingbird.

stories.title: The Great Gatsby
stories.synopsis: West Egg, 1922. A mansion next door throws parties without inviting anyone. The owner — Gatsby — has, you'll find, planned this evening for five years.

stories.title: The Catcher in the Rye
stories.synopsis: Pencey Prep, December. You've been expelled. You take the train to New York. You have three days before your parents find out.

stories.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
stories.sourceTitle: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
stories.synopsis: A cupboard under the stairs. A letter brought by owl. A platform between nines and tens. You're a wizard, Harry.

stories.title: The Hobbit
stories.synopsis: Bag End. A round door. Thirteen dwarves on your doorstep singing about gold. There and back again, the wizard says, like that's a small thing.

stories.title: The Lord of the Rings
stories.synopsis: Bag End, again. Bilbo's gift is, you'll learn, a curse. The road goes ever on, and you are walking it on small hairy feet.

stories.title: Crime and Punishment
stories.synopsis: St. Petersburg, summer. You are a starving student. You think, very seriously, that some men are above the law. You decide to test the theory on a pawnbroker.

stories.title: War and Peace
stories.synopsis: Russia, 1805. Drawing rooms and battlefields, both crowded. You are Pierre, an awkward heir who has, somehow, just inherited the largest fortune in the empire.

stories.title: Anna Karenina
stories.synopsis: Imperial Russia. All happy families are alike; each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way. You're about to make a new way.

stories.title: Moby-Dick
stories.synopsis: Call me Ishmael. New Bedford. Nantucket. The Pequod. A captain with a leg of bone and a grudge as big as the ocean.

stories.title: The Odyssey
stories.synopsis: Ten years home from Troy. You are Odysseus. The sea has, against all reason, opinions. Penelope weaves and unweaves and waits.

stories.title: Hamlet
stories.synopsis: Elsinore, winter. Your father is dead. Your uncle is on the throne and in your mother's bed. A ghost is on the battlement and wants a word.

stories.title: Frankenstein
stories.synopsis: Ingolstadt. You are a brilliant student. You have figured out, alone in a garret, how to give life. You have not figured out what to do with what you make.

stories.title: Dracula
stories.synopsis: London by mail coach. A solicitor's clerk goes to Transylvania for a real estate sale. The count, you'll find, casts no reflection.

stories.title: Beloved
stories.synopsis: Ohio, after the war. 124 is haunted. Your past walks up the road one day and sits on the porch and asks for water.

stories.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
stories.synopsis: Macondo. A town founded between a river and a swamp. Your family is the Buendía family. The world will come for you, slowly, in seven generations.

stories.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
stories.synopsis: 221B Baker Street. A cab in the rain. A client with a peculiar problem. You are, today, Holmes. The game, as he often says, is afoot.

stories.title: Don Quixote
stories.synopsis: La Mancha. You read too many books and got the wrong ideas. Today you put on a rusted helmet and call your old horse Rocinante. You will be, you have decided, a knight.

stories.title: A Tale of Two Cities
stories.synopsis: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times. London and Paris. A doctor recalled from the dead. A daughter. A revolution. A man who looks too much like another.

stories.title: And Then There Were None
stories.synopsis: Soldier Island. Ten guests. Each has, by the host's letter, an unconfessed crime. One by one a nursery rhyme is being acted out.

stories.title: Brave New World
stories.synopsis: World State, six hundred years on. Ford bless us. The soma is free. The conditioning is finished by age six. You're an Alpha-Plus, slightly maladjusted, slightly too much.

stories.title: Fahrenheit 451
stories.synopsis: Your job is to burn books. You wear a salamander and a number. Tonight, you'll meet a girl named Clarisse who asks if you're happy.

stories.title: Jane Eyre
stories.synopsis: Gateshead, Lowood, Thornfield. You are small and plain and on fire on the inside. The master of the house has, you'll learn, a wife in the attic.

stories.title: Stuck in the Elevator
stories.synopsis: Floor 23. The lights flicker. Three strangers. The fire alarm just went off.

stories.title: The Lost Dog
stories.synopsis: Saturday morning. A small wet dog on your porch with no tags. The rain isn't stopping.

stories.title: Airport at 5 a.m.
stories.synopsis: Your flight is in ninety minutes. The taxi smells like coffee and bad news.

stories.title: Wrong Number
stories.synopsis: A voice on the line says, 'You weren't supposed to pick up.'

stories.title: The Bundle on the Doorstep
stories.synopsis: A basket. A baby. A note: 'I trust you.' You don't know who 'I' is.

stories.title: Locksmith at 2 a.m.
stories.synopsis: You answer the after-hours line. The voice is small and far away.
